investigations.name: caspule-nfsim-multi-scale-coupling
investigations.title: CASPULE-NFSim Multiscale Coupling
investigations.description: Two studies probe the CASPULE + NFSim composite at different levels of spatial complexity: dimerization (simple pair formation) and polymer fractionation (size-selective harvesting of clusters up to 4 bonds per atom). Both use the same three-component wiring: CASPULE (MD) → ObservableDetector (spatial→non-spatial bridge) → NFSim (rule-based kinetics).
investigations.question: Can bond-aware spatial MD (CASPULE) be tightly coupled to non-spatial rule-based kinetics (NFSim) via an observable detector, and does this coupling produce qualitatively different dynamics than running each simulator independently?
investigations.hypothesis: The ObservableDetector bridge enables bidirectional information flow: spatial cluster structure drives NFSim species pools, and NFSim reaction outcomes (atom removal) feed back into CASPULE. This coupling should produce emergent dynamics — e.g. depleted monomer pools that slow bond formation, and NFSim steady-states that reflect the spatial cluster-size distribution — that neither simulator can reproduce alone.
